cosmeticstudio.gui.title: Cosmetic Studio
cosmeticstudio.gui.drag_hint: Drag to rotate · scroll to zoom
cosmeticstudio.gui.hide_real_pet_tip: Hides your own SkyBlock pet (and its name tag) on your screen only. Not needed with "Replace my SkyBlock pet", which hides the real pet model automatically and puts your pick in its place.
cosmeticstudio.gui.speed_unverified: Animation speed not verified yet (see MISSING_DATA.md)
cosmeticstudio.gui.not_dyeable: %s isn't dyeable — only leather-based armor can be dyed in SkyBlock.
cosmeticstudio.gui.empty_slot: Nothing worn here. Cosmetics you pick apply to whatever you wear in this slot.
cosmeticstudio.gui.rune_not_allowed: In SkyBlock this rune only goes on %s. Enable "Allow any rune on any piece" in the config to use it here.
cosmeticstudio.gui.effect_missing: Particle effect not verified yet — no particles until it's filled in (MISSING_DATA.md).
cosmeticstudio.gui.effect_approx_off: Only an unverified approximation exists; turn on "Show unverified rune effects" in the config to see it.
cosmeticstudio.gui.selected: Selected %s — press Apply or Done to save
cosmeticstudio.config.title: Cosmetic Studio Settings
cosmeticstudio.config.show_mine.tip: Turn off to see your normal armor and no custom pet.
cosmeticstudio.config.show_others.tip: Show dyes/runes/pets of other Cosmetic Studio users (needs a sync server).
cosmeticstudio.config.show_others_pets.t: Show custom pets of other Cosmetic Studio users.
cosmeticstudio.config.show_others_pet_na: Show the name tags other players gave their pets.
cosmeticstudio.config.only_skyblock.tip: Only show cosmetics while the scoreboard says you are in SkyBlock.
cosmeticstudio.config.particles.tip: Master switch for rune particles. Also follows the vanilla Particles video setting.
cosmeticstudio.config.no_particles_dunge: Disable rune particles in the Catacombs for performance.
cosmeticstudio.config.no_particles_kuudr: Disable rune particles in Kuudra's Hollow for performance.
cosmeticstudio.config.any_rune.tip: Allow runes on armor pieces SkyBlock doesn't normally allow them on.
cosmeticstudio.config.unverified_runes.t: Show approximate particle effects for runes whose real effect hasn't been verified yet (see MISSING_DATA.md).
cosmeticstudio.config.sync_url_tip: Your self-hosted Cosmetic Studio sync server. Only this server is contacted; nothing goes through Hypixel.
cosmeticstudio.config.delete_data_tip: Removes your cosmetics and sessions from the sync server.
cosmeticstudio.gui.save_preset_tip: Saves your whole outfit (all armor + pet) as a new preset. Leave the name empty to auto-name it.
cosmeticstudio.gui.preset_loaded_any: Preset loaded — close or press Done to keep it
cosmeticstudio.presets.title: Presets
cosmeticstudio.presets.empty: No presets yet — name your outfit above and press Save current.
